name: rift-week9-1.5b-fedlora-comparison-v1

gates.primary: paired comparison under the same async trace; report quality, harmful updates, coverage and wall-clock together

notes: fedavg_lora is factor-space FedAvg over client LoRA B/A parameters.

flora_lora uses the official FLoRA B-horizontal/A-vertical stacking equation; in this immediate-async runner the arriving block is the exact client innovation and is recompressed only at the shared server rank cap.
fedex_lora folds the exact mean-product residual into a separate frozen-base residual path.
florg uses a single trainable latent matrix, Gram aggregation and Procrustes alignment; it is not a two-factor LoRA adapter.
All methods share the same Dolly split, client partitions, arrival trace, local budget and held-out evaluation.
raw and freshness remain matched async controls; they are not claimed as external paper reproductions.
